name: Orange Tunisie Data Center Kalaa Kebira
notes: New Tier III next-generation data center at Kalaa Kebira (Sousse governorate), inaugurated 5 May 2025 by Orange Tunisie in presence of the Minister of Communication Technologies; ~1,000 m2 facility designed and built by Tunisian companies; serves Orange internal needs and B2B cloud/hosting services; connected to local fiber.

name: EO Data Center Enfidha
notes: Tier III carrier-neutral colocation/cloud data center in Zone Industrielle Enfidha II (Lots N47-48, Enfidha, Sousse governorate), near Enfidha-Hammamet airport and Tunis-Sousse highway; first sovereign cloud provider in Tunisia, N-Cloud labeled, ISO 27001/PCI-DSS; initial ~250 m2 hall expandable to ~1,000 m2; ~1 MW installed power; founded 2011; partners incl. IBM, Orange Tunisie, Tunisie Telecom; near subsea cable landing points.

name: STEG Data Center Sfax
developer: STEG (Societe Tunisienne de l'Electricite et du Gaz)
notes: STEG-owned data center in Sfax; engineering firm BIMDC carried out renovation of the technical installations (execution dossiers), 350 m2, completed 2024; evidence is a consultant portfolio entry, not an official STEG announcement.
